title: modernize pipe id parsed as u64 then narrowed to u32 without range check — ids ≥ 2^32 silently wrap onto a different pipe
detail: strconv.parse_uint returns u64; u32(fid) wraps out-of-range ids onto a different live pipe, blessing a wrong-but-self-consistent golden (legacy_modernized.log.bin). Weights got this exact fix; the new modernize verb replicates the unchecked pattern.
recommended_fix: Reject fid > max(u32) at parse, mirroring the weights range-check guard, before the narrowing cast in the modernize (and sibling id) cases.
